note: Clipboard.js integrates the external clipboard.js JS library. It provides four field formatters (clipboard_button, clipboard_snippet, clipboard_textfield, clipboard_textarea) for string/email/link/integer/decimal/float/slug/slug_path fields, each with settings label (default 'Click to copy'), alert_style (tooltip|alert|none, default tooltip) and alert_text (default 'Copied!'); and four theme hooks (clipboardjs_button/snippet/textarea/textfield). No config page, permission, or Drush. The external clipboard.js library must be at DRUPAL_ROOT/libraries/clipboard/dist/clipboard.js. Medium cases seed a string field with a known clipboard formatter/alert_style and read the display config back via drush; hard cases switch a field's formatter to a clipboard one and change the formatter label, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal clipboardjs module, how do I add a 'copy to clipboard' button to a text field's output, and what are the formatter machine names it provides?
evals.expected_output: On the entity bundle's Manage display page choose one of the Clipboard.js formatters: clipboard_button, clipboard_snippet, clipboard_textfield, or clipboard_textarea. They apply to string, email, link, integer, decimal, float, slug and slug_path fields.

evals.prompt: What settings does a clipboardjs field formatter expose, and what are the options for the confirmation/alert style?
evals.expected_output: Each formatter has label (button/hovertip text, default 'Click to copy'), alert_style (one of tooltip, alert, none; default tooltip) and alert_text (confirmation, default 'Copied!').

evals.prompt: How can custom code render a clipboardjs copy control in a render array or form, and what external dependency must be installed for clipboardjs to work?
evals.expected_output: Use one of the theme hooks (#theme => 'clipboardjs_button' | 'clipboardjs_snippet' | 'clipboardjs_textarea' | 'clipboardjs_textfield') with #value/#label/#alert_style/#alert_text. The external clipboard.js library (v2.0.11) must be placed at DRUPAL_ROOT/libraries/clipboard/dist/clipboard.js.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_cjs_known that shows a copy-to-clipboard control. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me which clipboardjs formatter it uses and its alert style.
evals.expected_output: field_cjs_known uses the clipboard_button formatter with alert_style 'alert': core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_cjs_known.type = clipboard_button, settings.alert_style = alert. Discoverable via drush cget core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_cjs_known.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article field field_cjs_style uses a clipboardjs formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me whether it shows a confirmation after copying, and which alert_style value produces that.
evals.expected_output: No confirmation is shown: the clipboard_textarea formatter on field_cjs_style has alert_style set to 'none'. Discoverable via drush cget core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_cjs_style.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text field field_cjs_task that currently renders as plain text. Using clipboardjs, change its display so the value is shown with a copy-to-clipboard control. Apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cjs_task component uses a Clipboard.js formatter (clipboard_button / clipboard_snippet / clipboard_textfield / clipboard_textarea). Set via Manage display or the entity_display API.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article field field_cjs_lbl uses a clipboardjs Button formatter whose copy label is the default 'Click to copy'. Change the formatter's label to 'Copy value' and apply it to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cjs_lbl component keeps a Clipboard.js formatter and its settings.label is 'Copy value'. Set via the formatter settings on Manage display or the entity_display API.
